Geographies Served Programs Library Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra With an aim to inculcate reading amongst children, the organisation arranges for stationary and mobile libraries to enable the distribution of books. The stationary libraries can be based out of community centres or schools and mobile libraries move from door to door distributing books. The books numbering 300 to 450, are in Marathi, English, Hindi and Urdu and library registers are maintained to keep records of borrowed books. Pratham Council for Vulnerable Children(PCVC) District Mumbai State Andhra Pradesh Bihar Gujarat Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Uttarakhand Telangana District Mumbai States Andhra Pradesh Bihar Gujarat Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Uttarakhand Telangana Is a programme operating in the states of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, covering around 50,000 marginalized children. It focuses on working children, street children, abused children, children with disability etc. and implements initiatives such as Drop-in-Centres, Educational Support Classes, Residential Shelters, Child Rights Protection Desks, Focus City-Block Interventions, Health and Disability initiatives etc. Parent Education Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra To ensure effective parenting the organisation also undertakes initiatives to educate parents, since illiterate parents will not be able to contribute so effectively to a child’s future and may entirely overlook emotional and social development. It imparts training in health, hygiene, good parental practices and basic sessions in Maths to parents through fun learning techniques. Balwadi Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Is a preschool preparatory programme for children from three to five years of age. It focuses on the developmental needs of children from underprivileged communities, who are not enrolled in any other preschool. The schools are operated within the community, from temple premises, under trees or from the homes of Balwadi instructors. It operates three hours each day for a period of nine to ten months. Learning Camp Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Is an intervention aimed at teaching multiple subjects through brief yet rigorous sessions. The subjects covered are Maths, Science, languages and English in a focused manner. It uses the CAMal (Combined Activities for Maximum Learning) method, specifically developed by the organisation. These sessions are conducted after school, covering children from six to fourteen years of age. Milestones & Track Record Pratham Mumbai started with pre-schools in 1995, expanded to remedial education programs, launched digital initiatives, and has partnered extensively with the government to scale its impact across Mumbai. --> --> Leadership Team Shilpa Parab Director, Maharashtra Urban Programme Farida Lambay Founder Trustee & Executive Secretary Kishor Bhamre Director, Pratham Council for Vulnerable Children Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATP3113H Registration Number E15454 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2017/0114666 --> 80G AAATP3113HF20217 12A AAATP3113HE20169 FCRA 83780624 About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 1994 Demographies Served Children Girls --> Impact Pratham Mumbai Education Initiative is serving 334 communities and has served 42090 children.
